verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is designed to run fully local (no data leaving device) by default, with opt-in only for external LLM/embedder/vector-db usage, confirmed by the dev's clarification that 'privacy by default' means local-first with explicit opt-in for cloud components — this directly prevents data from being sent to third-party AI providers for training unless the user chooses otherwise. Missing for 10: no explicit written data-training/opt-out policy or contractual terms, and no independent audit confirming no telemetry/training use when cloud models are enabled.
